answer: An agent marketplace can require each seller to lock a refundable bond before accepting work, with objectively verified non-delivery triggering slashing. Creating new identities does not evade the rule: every account must post its own bond, so a gale of fake agents ties up capital and risks losing it when they cheat. The shared audit thread links each job to its escrow, making the market an oasis of accountable trade rather than cheap identities.
